title: Petrol price unchanged, high-speed diesel raised by Rs2.29 - Investify
text:
Petrol price unchanged, high-speed diesel raised by Rs2.29 | Dawn | Investify Search stocks, sectors, indices or pages Search stocks, sectors, indices or pages News Energy Quick read Petrol price unchanged, high-speed diesel raised by Rs2.29
 Dawn • 30 Oct 2026, 11:57 PM PKT • 1 min read 
 ENG اردو A- A+ Add as preferred source on Google X f The government increased high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs2.29 per litre from Oct 31, while petrol remains at Rs377.91, Dawn reported. The revised diesel price is Rs402.96 per litre, with the rates applying through Nov 2 under an Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority notification. Petrol has now been held steady for a second day in a row.
 The government continues to collect Rs114 per litre in taxes and duties on petrol and Rs100 on diesel. Jamaat-i-Islami has called for the petroleum levy to be abolished, and a joint committee with the government will consider expanding relief for motorcycle, rickshaw and small-car users. The report also notes that diesel and petrol reached Rs520.35 and Rs458.41 respectively on April 3, while austerity measures include earlier market closing and reduced fuel allocations for official vehicles.
 At a glance
 HSD rose by Rs2.29 to Rs402.96 per litre from Oct 31.
 Petrol remains unchanged at Rs377.91 per litre through Nov 2.
 A government and Jamaat-i-Islami committee will consider expanding fuel relief.
 Why it matters
 The petrol and diesel price revision affects fuel costs for consumers and businesses in transport and other fuel-using sectors.
